entities.name: Boar
entities.description: A stout-bodied, short-legged, omnivorous, hoofed mammal found on many planes; domesticated boars are pigs.

entities.name: Ancestor
entities.description: A figure the Daru Plains nomads of Dominaria believe wrathfully incarnated as boars after witnessing human cruelty.

entities.name: Daru Plains
entities.description: Plains on Dominaria whose nomads hold beliefs about boars.

entities.name: Somberwald
entities.description: A woodland on Innistrad home to large, monstrous boars.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: An Eldrazi whose arrival made Innistrad's boars more aggressive and monstrous.

entities.name: Vorracs
entities.description: Large boar beasts with coppery tusks found in the Tangle on Mirrodin, used by elves as mounts.

entities.name: Vulshok
entities.description: A people of Mirrodin who tamed boars as livestock.

entities.name: Gruul Zhur-Taa Clan
entities.description: A Gruul clan on Ravnica that awaits the awakening of Ilharg and raids with Batterboars.

entities.name: Ilharg, the Raze Boar
entities.description: An ancient boar god of the Gruul who will mount a fiery rampage and raze the over-civilized world.

entities.name: End-Raze
entities.description: The prophesied rampage of Ilharg to raze the over-civilized world of Ravnica.

entities.name: Gore Swine
entities.description: Boars regarded in old Tarkir as exemplars of the virtues of the Mardu Horde.

entities.name: Yasharn, Implacable Earth
entities.description: A notable boar on Zendikar who is also an Elemental.

events.summary: The arrival of Emrakul on Innistrad makes the boars more aggressive and monstrous.
events.quote: When Emrakul arrived, the boars became even more aggressive and monstrous.

events.summary: Some Vulshok-tamed boars on Mirrodin are phyrexianized and transformed into Razor Swine.
events.quote: Several of these boars were phyrexianized, being transformed into Razor Swine

relations.quote: await the awakening of Ilharg, the Raze Boar
Other boars were tamed by the Vulshok as livestock.

rejected.note: regarded as exemplars of Mardu virtues
rejected.quote: the Gore Swine were regarded as exemplars of the virtues
